title: Ladybug dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Legs dancing -->
  <g stroke='#3d2b1f' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M30 62 Q20 55 18 45'/>
    <path d='M32 70 Q22 72 14 68'/>
    <path d='M36 76 Q30 84 24 88'/>
    <path d='M70 62 Q80 55 82 45'/>
    <path d='M68 70 Q78 72 86 66'/>
    <path d='M64 76 Q70 84 78 86'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#e8262a'/>
  <path d='M50 36 L50 88' stroke='#b01818' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Wing split lighter shade -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='26' fill='none' stroke='#ff5a52' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='54' r='5' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='54' r='5' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='70' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='3' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='14' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a5a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='27' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='27' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='27.5' r='2' fill='#1a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='27.5' r='2' fill='#1a1a2a'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 35 Q50 39 55 35' stroke='#ff8a8a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <path d='M44 18 Q38 8 32 6' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='6' r='3' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <path d='M56 18 Q62 8 68 6' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='6' r='3' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <!-- Arms dancing up -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q22 40 18 32' stroke='#3d2b1f' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 48 Q78 40 82 32' stroke='#3d2b1f' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
